title: Outlet to Wing Break Start
description: A defensive rebound is outletted to a sprinting wing, practising the very first pass that actually starts a fast break off a miss.

content.objective: Deliver a fast, accurate outlet pass the instant a rebound is secured to start the break quickly.
content.setup: A shot is missed on purpose near the rim; a rebounder and a sprinting wing target set up.
instructions: The rebounder secures the ball with both hands and pivots away from pressure.
The wing sprints immediately toward the sideline without waiting for the outlet.
The rebounder delivers a sharp outlet pass ahead of the sprinting wing.
The wing catches in stride and continues up the floor to finish or find a trailer.
coachingPoints: Outlet within one or two seconds of securing the rebound.
Lead the pass ahead of the sprint, not directly at the receiver.
Wing should be sprinting before the outlet even arrives, not waiting flat-footed.
commonMistakes: Holding the rebound too long before outletting.
Wing standing still waiting for the pass instead of already sprinting.
Forcing a play before the numbers advantage is actually clear.
content.safety: Make sure the sprint lane is clear of any other drill happening nearby.
